end.summary:
Practised counting sides and corners of 2D shapes.
Counted triangle sides as 3 and quadrilateral sides as 4.
Named triangles from 3 sides and 3 corners, even when turned or tilted.
Used finger-pointing and counting to check sides and corners.
Teach-back was not passed.
end.parentNote: Asha practised counting sides and corners, including shapes shown in different positions. They used finger-pointing and counting, and explained that a shape with three sides remains a triangle when turned or tilted. No mix-up was recorded. At home, ask them to count the sides and corners of everyday shapes, turning the paper to check that the count stays the same.
